effect_description_eng:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon card and 1 [LIBERATOR] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Suzune Kazuki]s are played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower [LIBERATOR] trait card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
